intent: Label the user applies or manages: removable, selectable, with optional count, status dot, or avatar.
useWhen: Filter chips the user picks or clears
Keywords, topics, or labels the user adds to a record
Assigned people or teams shown as removable labels
Removable chips inside another control, like picked values in a Select
doNotUseWhen: Read-only status or category set by the system (Paid, Overdue, Beta) — use Badge
Overflow +N counts — use Badge (Select) or Count
Primary or secondary actions — use Button
A person on their own — use Avatar
Single-choice segmented options — use ButtonGroup or Tabs

onRemove.note: (event) => void; used when removable. The event lets a parent control stop propagation.

selectable.note: Leading kit Checkbox, labelled by the Tag text

count.note: Trailing kit Count, size sm, intent neutral, subtle

dot.note: Leading status dot; decorative, the text carries the meaning

avatar.note: { name: string; src?: string } — leading kit Avatar sized to the Tag (20/24/32px via space tokens) with an even space.inset.2xs inset when it leads; sm shows one initial

id.note: Checkbox id when selectable; generated when omitted

requirements: Plain Tag is a span with readable text
Selectable: the kit Checkbox is the control; it is labelled by the Tag text and the text is its <label>
Removable: the X is a button with aria-label Remove {children}
disabled sets aria-disabled and disables both the checkbox and the remove button
Dot is aria-hidden; never the only signal
Checkbox and remove button show a focus-visible ring using --border-focus

doNot: Do not invent a local Tag, Chip, or FilterChip
Do not use Tag for system status — use Badge
Do not use raw hex or primitive --color-* ramps
Do not make the whole Tag a button; only the checkbox and the remove control are interactive
Do not stack more than one leading visual (pick one of checkbox, dot, avatar) unless the design needs it
snippet:
<Tag removable onRemove={() => {}}>Design</Tag>
<Tag selectable defaultSelected count={4}>Engineering</Tag>
<Tag dot="success">Active</Tag>
<Tag avatar={{ name: "Ana Ruiz" }}>Ana Ruiz</Tag>
